summary: A modal dialog with a title, optional description and body, and an optional cancel/confirm pair.

props.name: triggerIcon
props.description: A glyph beside the trigger's label.

props.name: triggerIconPosition
props.description: Which end of the trigger `triggerIcon` sits at.

props.name: triggerTone
props.description: Color: `neutral` or `danger`, for a destructive confirmation.

props.name: triggerSize
props.description: Footprint: `md` or `sm`, for a trigger nested inside other content, like a row action.

props.name: onTriggerClick
props.description: Fires when the trigger is pressed, before the dialog opens - for capturing which row triggered it, say, in a dialog reused across a list.

props.name: header
props.description: Content above the title - an avatar and name block, say. Centred in its own padded row.

props.name: title
props.description: The dialog's heading, wired up by Base UI's own Dialog.Title.

props.name: description
props.example: Your Sales Site project now has a pending collaboration request from John.
props.description: The body text, wired up by Base UI's own Dialog.Description.

props.name: children
props.description: The body, below the description. Form fields and anything else go here - style them yourself.

props.name: confirmLabel
props.description: The confirming button's label. No footer renders without this, so an informational dialog closes by its X alone.

props.name: onConfirm
props.description: Called when the confirm button is pressed. The dialog closes either way.

props.name: confirmTone
props.description: Color of the confirm button: `primary` or `danger`, for a destructive action like a delete.

props.name: shape
props.description: Corner radius on the popup and its buttons.

props.name: animate
props.description: The backdrop's fade and the popup's scale-in. Turn it off for an instant dialog, or when the user has asked for reduced motion.

props.name: className
props.description: Appended to the trigger's classes, for anything the component leaves unset - a margin, `fs-0` in a flex row. It will not reliably override what the component already sets: which of two utilities wins is decided by the stylesheet's rule order, not by the order you write them.
